text: 从中国证监会了解到，今年前三季度，沪深两市上市公司实现净利润5.1万亿元，创2022年以来新高。截至10月31日，沪深两市5224家上市公司披露了2026年三季报，73%的上市公司实现盈利。前三季度，沪深两市上市公司实现营业收入56.6万亿元，净利润5.1万亿元，同比分别增长5.8%、8.5%，规模及增速均创2022年以来新高。（央视）
text_en: According to the CSRC, in the first three quarters of this year, listed companies on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges achieved a combined net profit of 5.1 trillion yuan, a new high since 2022. As of October 31, 5,224 listed companies on the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges had disclosed their 2026 third-quarter reports, with 73% of them profitable. In the first three quarters, listed companies on the two exchanges recorded operating revenue of 56.6 trillion yuan and net profit of 5.1 trillion yuan, up 5.8% and 8.5% YoY respectively, with both scale and growth rates hitting new highs since 2022. (CCTV)
